text:
zoe_cs: FYI - Meridian Labs (acct 3120) invoice #9021 autopay ran and card auth timed out then returned `do_not_honor`. Theyre in onboarding and need partial access unlocked. Customer asked if they can split payment: wire for the onboarding fee and virtual card for remaining balance. Thoughts?

harris_fin: paste gateway decline details + last4. Also confirm PO#. Splitting payment is fine but we need clear bookkeeping and reference on both payments.

zoe_cs: last4 9987. Declines: `authorization_timeout`, then `do_not_honor`. Attempts at 2026-04-02T12:07Z and 12:33Z. PO on file: PO-10855. Customer message: "We can wire $5k for onboarding today and put the rest on a virtual card. Please provide wire beneficiary details and a one-time virtual card link. Disable auto card retries."

marta_billing: Agree split is ok. Process: 1) disable auto card retries; 2) create two payment instructions on invoice 9021 (payment_method=wire for $5,000, payment_method=one_time_paylink for remainder); 3) require customer to include exact refs: "Invoice 9021 / PO-10855 / WIRE" and for card link include invoice ref. We need SWIFT copy for the wire and the paylink token once used. Waive onboarding late fee.

billing-bot: [automated] Payment log: invoice=9021 attempts=2 status=failed gateway=stripe region=us-west-2

sam_sales: Sales approves split to avoid blocking pilot. Please include language in CS message: "Weve paused card retries. If you choose to wire $5,000 today, please include reference Invoice 9021 / PO-10855 / WIRE. Well send a secure one-time card link for the remainder; use it within 24h."

harris_fin: Also confirm accounting entries: split will produce two clearing lines on the same invoice. Finance will mark partial paid after wire clears and mark fully paid after paylink settlement. Ensure both receipts go into the billing ticket.

legal-bot: No contract issues with split payment. Ensure customer consent email captured and record which portion is via wire vs card for audit.

marta_billing: I'll create the manual-payment plan and disable auto-retries. Creating one-time card link with amount remaining = invoice_total - 5000. Notify CS to send both instructions securely. Ticket will be created.

zoe_cs: Sending secure message to customer now with wire template and paylink note. Customer replied: "Thanks, wire will go out by 5pm PST with ref. We'll use the virtual card link by EOD tomorrow."

billing-bot: Ticket BILL-5012 created: invoice 9021 split payment (wire + one-time paylink).

harris_fin: Action items: marta_billing to create manual payment plan & paylink (eta 30m). zoe_cs attach customer consent and SWIFT copy when received. Finance to reconcile on receipt. Escalate if not settled in 48h.

zoe_cs: will update thread with SWIFT or paylink confirmation. Thanks everyone.
